text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYBEAN SALE - South Korea bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soybeans at a basis price over CBOT November amounting to about $305 C & F. Shipment was set for the first half of November from the U.S. Gulf.

WHEAT SALE - Moroccan millers group Comite Professionnel de la Minoterie bought 25,000 tonnes of Canadian durum wheat at $218 per tonne, cost and freight, European grain traders said. Millers made the purchase at a November 1 tender. The wheat is for delivery between November 25 and November 30.

WHEAT SALE - Pakistan bought 270,000 tonnes U.S. soft white wheat for November 12-30 delivery. It bought four lots of 20,000 tonnes at $143.31 a tonne, $143.67, $144.04 and $144.42 from Columbia Grain. The deal also included 25,000 tonnes at $143.88 from Granplex and three lots of 20,000 tonnes at $144.41, $144.78 and $144.97 from United Grain. Three lots of 25,000 tonnes were bought at $145.18, $145.54 and $145.91 from Louis Dreyfus. One lot of 10,000 tonnes at $145.58 and 5,000 tonnes at $145.95 was from Harvest States. One lot of 15,000 tonnes was bought at $145.67 a tonne from Continental Grain.

RICE SALE - Brunei bought 33,000 tonnes of high quality rice from the Thai government for 1997 delivery. The amount was 6,000 tonnes more than Brunei bought from Thailand last year. Price details were unavailable.

WHEAT TENDER - Moroccan millers have again postponed a tender for the import of 20,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat for delivery November 20-30, European grain traders said. The Moroccan Millers Association had already postponed the tender to October 31 from October 28. Traders said they expected millers to re-tender for the wheat later this week.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it would tender Nov 13 for up to 80,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat, ordinary protein, for Bangladesh. Shipment was for Dec 1-25, 1996.
- The CCC said is to tender Nov 6 for up to 10,000 tonnes of northern spring wheat for donation to Ghana.
- CCC said it seeks up to 1,600 tonnes hard red winter wheat for Benin. The wheat was slated for Dec 1-25 shipment.

CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan will tender Tuesday for 20,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and 10,000 soybeans. Shipment is for Nov 15-30 from the U.S. Gulf or Dec 1-15 from the PNW, or Nov 20-Dec 5 from the U.S. Gulf or Dec 5-20 from PNW.

CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - Egypt extended until 1000 GMT November 6 the deadline for bids for 30,000 tonnes U.S. or Argentine yellow corn and 30,000 tonnes of soybean, any origin. The old deadline was October 30.
CORN TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday invited tenders to supply 18,000 tonnes of maize, with a shipment date of November or December. The tender closes November 5.
SOYOIL TENDER - The CCC is to tender Nov 6 for 13,000 tonnes of crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. The oil was slated for Dec 14-30 delivery.

MARKET TALK - The Australian wheat industry would not survive a new trade war with Argentina, the European Union and other major grains producers at current prices, Jeff Arney, president of the Grains Council of Australia, said.

... The sharp fall in U.S. corn prices to 14-month lows last week will not trigger immediate buying among East Asian buyers because it would be more than offset by a rise in freight rates, regional traders said on Monday.

... Turkish farm quarantine officials are still inspecting a cargo of 15,000 tonnes of U.S. milling wheat for ergot fungus and no decision on whether to reject it has been made, Agriculture Minister Musa Demirci said.
